question.text: In an uniformly charged sphere of total charge Q and radius $\mathrm{R},$ the electric field $\mathrm{E}$ is plotted as function of distance from the centre. The graph which would correspond to the above will be

solution.text:
Electric field inside the uniformly charged sphere varies linearly, $E=\frac{k Q}{R^{3}} r,(r \leq R)$ while outside the sphere, it varies as inverse
square of distance, $E=\frac{k Q}{r^{2}} ;(r \geq R)$ which is correctly represented in option (c).
